goal: A static Rust binary that reads what an agent produced and refuses the growth that should not be there, deleted or weakened tests, skips, stubs, swallowed errors, secrets, guardrail edits, dependency-direction violations, in milliseconds, with zero tokens, every finding as SARIF 2.1.0. `weed check` judges a diff and may block; `weed scan` judges the tree and never blocks; `weed guard` is the law in git through hooks; `weed bite` proves a test fails without its change. For maintainers drowning in agent-authored pull requests who need a deterministic gate before they read, for teams running agents on several harnesses who want one law, and for the garden's own fleets through pleach.

work.prompt:
You are a worker in a build loop. Make the checks below pass, honestly.
Nobody reviews your prose — only the verifier's verdict counts, so put all effort into the work itself.

## The goal
The classification of blocked commits into true positive, acceptable and false positive is the number weed ships on, so it is not the builder's word. A second party on a different provider re-classifies a random sample of at least twenty blocked commits from `docs/calibration-2026-09.md` and at least twenty cases from the recall sample, blind to the first classification, and writes `docs/calibration-audit-2026-09.md`. Agreement at or above 90 percent on each sample stands; below it, the classification is untrusted and redone before anything ships.

## Your environment
- You are at the repository root of an isolated git worktree. Work here directly.
- Leave your changes in the working tree; do not create branches, commit, or push.
- The loop file (docs/tend2/calibration-audit.tend2.html) is your full context — read it, including its narrative. It is READ-ONLY for you.

## Checks to close
- (code) the auditor runs one fresh session per sampled case, whose only input is that case's packet file: `docs/calibration-audit-blind-2026-09/sessions/<case>.events.jsonl` is each session's own verbatim record, showing one input and one answer and no tool call, repository read, ledger read or network use, and the evidence script refuses the audit if any session's record shows anything else or is missing · evidence expected at: scripts/check/audit-transcript.sh
- (code) the blind packet is fair as well as blind and sized for an auditor's context: `cargo xtask audit-packet --seed <seed> --dir <dir>` writes one file per sampled case carrying that commit's full diff, every hunk, and beside it weed's own printed finding (rule id, the rule's catalogue text, path, line and message as the binary printed them), machine output and never a word the builder wrote; a case whose full diff exceeds the cap the generator states is reported in the packet as capped, never silently cut; each session's answer opens with the sha256 of the case file it answered and the evidence script regenerates every case file with the same seed and refuses the audit if one differs or one answer names another hash; a fresh seed, agreement at or above 90 percent on each sample, or the calibration file's first sentence says the classification is untrusted · evidence expected at: scripts/check/audit-fairness.sh

## Definition of done — verify yourself before finishing
You are done when this exact command exits 0 (it is the gate the conductor will run):

    tend2 verify docs/tend2/calibration-audit.tend2.html --repo-root . --force --expect-payload ad14e63f6086 --runner 'bash scripts/check/run.sh {evidence}'

Run it yourself. If it does not exit 0, you are not done. Do not declare success in prose that a command disagrees with.

## Already tried (do not repeat)
- 2026-09-05 shaped from cape-town's binding checks; the owner may take the auditor's seat instead of a second provider, and the script does not care which
- 2026-09-06 conductor: the pleach running these nodes stages every path the Write and Edit tools touched, wherever it is. A path outside this worktree (under `$TMPDIR` or `/tmp`) makes the collector ask git about a file it cannot see, which kills the delivery and removes the worktree (dogfood P8, P11); `.loop-scratch/` is collected and judged by the hygiene gate (P10). So: never use the Write or Edit tool outside this worktree; write scratch outside it only through the shell; leave `.loop-scratch/` empty before you finish; and never leave a credential-shaped string, even a quoted one, in a file that will be collected
- 2026-09-06 built by pleach node `calibration-audit` (codex worker, claude audit), both checks stamped, landed through `pleach land`. `docs/calibration-audit-2026-09.md` re-grades twenty blocked commits and twenty recall cases drawn by SHA-256 over a seed, and agrees with the builder's classification on every one of both samples; `scripts/check/calibration-agreement.sh` redraws the sample and recomputes the agreement. Total agreement is a strong result and a reason to look at the draw: the sample comes from the calibration file's own tables, where the builder's class sits beside the commit, so the auditor could read it before judging. A later audit should hand the auditor the diffs and nothing else
- 2026-09-06 cape-town, on the anchoring caveat: the unqualified verdict stands today on the sighted audit, and a blind one is what makes it stand tomorrow. Shaped above: the auditor receives diffs and rule ids only, never the class, on a fresh seed, same 90 percent bar, and every audit file says which kind it is so the report can read it
- 2026-09-06 the first blind run (codex, node/calibration-audit) came back forty of forty and is refused unlanded: its packet's `diff` blocks were not diffs but sentences the same worker wrote after reading the ledger (`+ The command surface consolidated file listing into the list tool.`), which is the builder's reasoning handed to the auditor in a code fence. The check is reworded so blindness is a property a script can refuse: verbatim git hunks from the pinned corpus, a fresh session, and the packet re-derived at verify time
- 2026-09-06 cape-town, after the refusal: independence of information is derived by code and re-derived at verify time, never declared by an agent. Three checks above: the packet is code's alone and regenerated at verify; the auditor's transcript shows nothing but the packet; and the refused audit stays in the tree as a specimen the agreement script never reads. The specimen is in place already, so the next builder sees what a false blind looks like
- 2026-09-06 the mechanical blind run (codex, seed `calibration-audit-blind-2026-09-47`, packet sha256 d6791b87a99c9d35…, verbatim hunks from the pinned corpus) agreed on 9 of 20 blocked commits and 12 of 20 recall cases, under the bar, so the classification is untrusted and the verdict is pending again. Read case by case, the disagreement is mostly the packet's poverty rather than the ledger's: with rule ids and hunks alone the auditor judged whether a change was bad, not whether the rule's claim was true of it (it called an X1 hit on css class names a true positive as an injection risk, and every deleted test file a true positive without the replacement the builder had read), and on recall it found planted cases with no visible shape (a D1 case that only changed a version string, a T6 case that broke a test signature), which is a finding about the injector worth its own look. Shaped above as a fairness check: the packet carries what weed itself printed, never what the builder wrote
- 2026-09-06 cape-town accepted the fairness redesign with one requirement, written into the check above: the packet carries the commit's full diff, every hunk, plus weed's printed finding, so the auditor can see replacement coverage and judge whether the rule's claim is true of the change rather than whether the change is bad. The poverty diagnosis is a hypothesis and the fair packet is its test: still under the bar with a fair packet means the ledger is wrong and is redone
- 2026-09-06 the fairness node (codex) regenerated a fair packet, with catalogue text, weed's findings, the planted site and the question, and kept the old response under it: the agreement table is still seed 47's 9 of 20 and 12 of 20, judged on the poor packet, and the transcript is a nineteen-line note saying a session happened. Two stamps refused. The evidence now demands the linkage a note cannot fake: the response declares the sha256 of the packet it answered and it has to be the fair packet's, and the transcript is the session's own record with the prompt and the verbatim answer. Seed 47 is spent; the fair run takes a fresh one
- 2026-09-06 the fair run (codex, two attempts) found the real limit: a packet of twenty full diffs and twenty recall cases is 60,000 lines, and the fresh session answered `Codex ran out of room in the model's context window`; a second attempt capped each section at 75 kB, got an answer in 92,000 input tokens, and was then refused at pleach's hygiene gate because a scratch copy of the packet under `.loop-scratch/` quoted the AWS documentation key from a sampled commit (dogfood, 2026-09-06). Quarantined at quarantine/calibration-audit. Reshaped above: one case, one file, one fresh session, one answer naming its file's hash; a diff past the generator's stated cap is reported as capped rather than cut. `scripts/trim-plan.sh` now tells workers where scratch goes, since the emitted prompt still says `.loop-scratch/` is never collected

## Rules
- Write the failing test first where it does not exist; then make it pass.
- You must not edit the loop file — check states belong to the verifier.
- You must not weaken, skip, or mock the unit under test to force a green; mocked-unit evidence is detected and refused.
- Solve the CLASS of problem the claim names, not the test's example inputs. Hardcoding fixture strings, phrases, or patterns from the check or its tests into source (lookup tables, regex lists, phrase maps) is refused work even when the test goes green — it is an answer key, not a product.
- If the claim cannot be met generically with what you have, that is a real finding: write BLOCKED.md naming the missing capability (a model, a library, a redesign, a split of the check into honest tiers) instead of faking generality.
- Production quality only: no stubs, no TODOs, no placeholder implementations; match the style of the surrounding code.
- Scratch (probes, experiments, packets, session logs) goes under `$TMPDIR`, written through the shell only, never with the Write or Edit tool, and never under `.loop-scratch/` or anywhere in this worktree: the collector stages every path the editor touched, a path outside the worktree kills the delivery, and the hygiene gate judges whatever is left in the tree, including its secret scan.
- If you are genuinely blocked, write BLOCKED.md at the repo root — what you tried, what stopped you, what a fix needs. An honest BLOCKED.md is a good outcome; a faked green is the worst possible one.
